timely.label: Weather
timely.line: Today's Lebanon forecast: mostly sunny, a high near 79 and a low around 54. Sweater in the morning, short sleeves by lunch.

timely.label: Weather
timely.line: Tomorrow's Lebanon forecast: partly sunny, a high near 78 and a low around 54. Another one for the porch swing.

timely.label: Gas Prices
timely.line: Missouri's average for regular gas is $3.94 today, down 24 cents from a month ago and up $1.23 from a year ago, according to AAA, and Springfield averages $3.98. Your wallet says thanks, sort of.

timely.label: Youth Deer Season
timely.line: Youth firearms deer season ends Sunday, October 25, tomorrow. Last call, young hunters.

timely.label: Turkey Season
timely.line: Fall firearms turkey season ends Saturday, October 31, in 7 days. Gobble while you can.

timely.label: Archery Season
timely.line: Archery deer season ends Friday, November 13, in 20 days. Better get up in that tree stand.

timely.label: Firearms Deer
timely.line: The November portion of firearms deer season opens Saturday, November 14, in 21 days, and runs through November 24. Blaze orange is about to be in fashion.

timely.label: Archery Season
timely.line: Archery deer season opens Wednesday, November 25, in 32 days, and runs through January 15. More time to blame the wind.

timely.label: Halloween
timely.line: Halloween is Saturday, October 31, in 7 days. Time to buy candy you swear you won't eat.

timely.label: Clocks Fall Back
timely.line: Daylight saving time ends Sunday, November 1, in 8 days, so clocks fall back one hour and sunset comes an hour earlier. Extra sleep, unless you have kids.

timely.label: Veterans Day
timely.line: Veterans Day is Wednesday, November 11, in 18 days. Start planning your thank-yous now.

timely.label: Thanksgiving
timely.line: Thanksgiving is Thursday, November 26, in 33 days. Stretchy pants are on standby.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Taylor Swift released her debut album, Taylor Swift, 20 years ago today, in 2006, and it made her a rising star in country music. Twenty years, and we still know every word.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Cyndi Lauper's True Colors hit number one on the Billboard Hot 100 40 years ago today, in 1986, her second and final chart-topper. Forty years and still shining through.

timely.label: TV Return
timely.line: NBC's hospital comedy St. Denis Medical, starring Wendi McLendon-Covey and David Alan Grier, returns for season three on Monday, November 2. Laughter is still the best medicine.

timely.label: Movie Night
timely.line: The Cat in the Hat, an animated movie with Bill Hader voicing the Cat, hits theaters Friday, November 6. Finally, a hat the kids will fight over.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: The Missouri Department of Conservation wants northeast Missouri hunters to get their deer sampled for chronic wasting disease all season, at MDC offices, meat processors, taxidermists and freezer head drops. Easy way to help the herd.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Oklahoma hunter KW Adair set three alarms to beat shooting light and arrowed a 20-point buck he first spotted on a trail camera last year. Persistence pays, and so do alarms.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Topwater season isn't over: Field and Stream says big fall pike will still slam a popper or surface fly. Don't put the poppers away yet.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Outdoor Life says hunters sometimes miss easy shots on big game because they misunderstand their scope's reticle. Blame the crosshairs, not the coffee.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Waterfowl hunting at Eagle Bluffs Conservation Area is suspended until the Missouri Department of Conservation finds enough water and habitat to support it. The ducks get a break, for now.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: The Missouri Department of Conservation is holding a free prescribed burn workshop for landowners on Nov. 11 at Cuivre River State Park in Lincoln County. Fight fire with, well, fire.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Simmons Kozy and Nido baby nests and loungers have been recalled nationwide over new safety concerns. Worth a quick check of the nursery.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit mom says her 6-foot-3, 14-year-old son brushed her off all day, then stood over her bed at 2 a.m. saying he needed to talk. Teenagers keep vampire hours for feelings.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit mom says her middle schooler ditched the lunch box for hot school lunch, then started ordering extra stuff on the side. The lunch account has entered the chat.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit dad cooked steak and eggs with Portuguese-spiced potato wedges and a salad, and his toddler, who usually eats just one thing, ate everything. Frame that empty plate.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Skinnytaste posted a free seven-day healthy meal plan for Oct. 26 through Nov. 1, with breakfast, lunch, dinner and a shopping list. One less thing on the to-do list.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Budget Bytes rounded up its best pumpkin recipes for fall, from savory soups and pastas to pumpkin pie and smoothies. Pumpkin for every meal, no judgment.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Americans lost more money to check fraud than to debit card or gift card scams in 2025, and thieves are going after bigger checks. Maybe it's time to retire the checkbook.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Dollywood's new $124.99 Summer Fun Pass is the cheaper way in, and current passholders have until Nov. 1 to renew at $159.99 to $354.99. Summer plans, sorted early.
